values.value: Rev rec rules missing schedule config
SELECT Id, Name FROM blng__RevenueRecognitionRule__c WHERE blng__Active__c = true AND blng__CreateRevenueSchedule__c = null
Revenue recognition rule "{Name}" missing schedule creation config
Active revenue recognition rule has no Create Revenue Schedule value set. Without an explicit selection, revenue may not be scheduled correctly.

Finds: Active blng__RevenueRecognitionRule__c records with blng__CreateRevenueSchedule__c null. Why it matters: Without an explicit Create Revenue Schedule value, revenue may not schedule correctly — recognition either fires immediately when it shouldn't or never fires when it should. ASC 606 / IFRS 15 risk. Suppress a finding: never; set the value explicitly. Disable the detector: leave on when using Salesforce Billing rev rec.
